scope_notes: Exact source bytes are preserved, including original operational paths. No rerun was made while packaging.

The two array-check carriers originally used read-only OSMO exec on live worker6 and cannot attach after task completion. Their REMOTE constants contain the complete CPU kernels; replay them against the extracted case2 archive and frozen Linux source/environment.

For an identical prefix check, restrict the events file to the source_events_prefix_bytes retained in its review and verify its source_events_prefix_sha256 first. The canonical derivative verifies these prefixes against final events.

The random kernel uses the laptop coefficient vector recorded in random-coefficient-array-review.json in its __LOCAL_REGENERATED__ substitution; the coefficients remain float64 through the frozen tensordot before casting to float32.
The feedback-prefix review is partial; it is not a substitute for the canonical all20-case audit.
Provider review joins canonical case summary/ledger hashes and verifies exact final accounting. Raw provider responses, image arrays, private catalogs, signed URLs and credentials are not included.
